source.snippet: Ask HN: Is there any Hacker News but for investing/trading/economics etc.? (4 points, 7 comments, Aug 2026) — community asking for a curated, high-signal forum for investing and trading discussion, similar to HN's format but focused on finance/economics.

problem_statement: Investors, traders, and economics enthusiasts lack a high-quality, curated community platform (like Hacker News) for substantive discussion of investing, trading, and economics — existing options are either too noisy (Reddit) or too niche/closed.
target_segment: Retail and semi-professional investors, traders, quant hobbyists, and finance professionals seeking peer discourse
notes: Multiple commenters engaged (7 comments). Implicit willingness to use a paid or freemium platform given HN's own model. Demand is for quality curation, not free content per se. Weak buyer signal — no explicit pay intent stated, but finance audiences are known high-LTV.
